answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 163153 Country: India Title: Is it fardh (mandatory) for a mother who is breastfeeding her child to fast or not? Question: Is it fardh (mandatory) for a mother who is breastfeeding her child to fast or not? Answer ID: 163153 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1024/885/B=11/1439) If by keeping fast in Ramadan the mother has not to experience any problem in breastfeeding her child and the child will not meet any harm then it is mandatory for the mother to observe the fasts. But in case of keeping fast if there is fear of life then the mother should not keep fast rather she can postpone. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
